correction.admission: For each previously unseen live session member, walk fresh parent/birth links to the recorded leader or a currently birth-verified captured descendant, reject cycles/oversized chains, missing/zombie parents and children predating parents, then reread the complete chain before storing any new member. Refuse unverifiable live orphans rather than adopting them by SID.
correction.identity: PID and birth match the recorded member; SID matches both record and leader; PGID matches that member's recorded PGID, not the root's; birth cannot precede the leader. The leader remains protected by its own original identity.
correction.signal: Require a recorded member before signals, then freshly validate leader if present and target PID/birth/SID/recorded PGID. Signal individual positive PIDs only, preserve benign ESRCH and signal receipts; no group-wide kill.
correction.retention: Keep captured descendants across parent/leader exit and legal reparenting; remove only absent/zombie members after identity validation. Scope failures remain errors, retain fixtures and preserve primary failures.
correction.bounds: No production bound, monitor cadence, timeout, CLI or inspector API change. Existing 300ms deliberate failure/refusal controls and reap/grace/output bounds remain unchanged. Successful live witnesses use the existing production execution bound only.
correction.testAcknowledgment: Generated parent waits for an owned file acknowledgment. The existing inspectorFactory queues a microtask from the real native session call; it writes the acknowledgment only after the wrapper's monitor records successful real ownership admission for that sample and the child PID/birth is present. Parent then exits; descendant remains live for cleanup. No blind sleep proves capture. Receipt records the child's actual PPID/SID/PGID, not the root's proxy values.
correction.testContractChange: The old optional periodicObservation=false performance comparison was removed from live descendant cases because a deliberately unsampled immediate orphan cannot satisfy verified ancestry. Existing after-leader-exit cleanup assertions are retained; normal retained/closed pipe cases and injected inspection failure are still tested.
limitations: Existing inspector discovery samples the root's session; a child that leaves before its first capture cannot be discovered/proven by that interface. Already captured foreign SID/group/birth changes are refused. No claim of exhaustive atomic fork tracing is made.
Fresh native validation and kill are not atomic; the pre-existing PID-reuse race between final read and signal remains explicit.
The exact CI child spawning call remains unmeasured; neither Bun, Docker, detached spawning nor setsid is asserted as its cause.
